facts.failed_command: A command that exits non-zero is heard as PostToolUse (posttooluse-blocked) with exit_code and the output; OpenCode's shim has no PostToolUseFailure.
facts.native_write: A write or edit outside the project first raises OpenCode's own ask ("Permission required: Access external directory"), heard as notification and permissionrequest. Allowed once, the wrap refuses it and the model is shown "PermissionDenied: FileSystem.writeFile (<path>)"; no PostToolUse follows.
facts.native_read: A read of a vault file is denied by purlis's pretooluse-read hook, and its reason reaches the model as the tool's error, word for word.
facts.web_fetch: webfetch is heard as PreToolUse (tool_name WebFetch); the proxy refuses an unlisted host and the model is shown "Transport error (GET <url>)". No PostToolUse follows.
facts.hook_exit_2: A PreToolUse hook's exit 2 blocks the call, and its standard error is what the model is shown.
facts.subagent: A task call is heard as pretooluse-dispatch, then the sub-agent's own hooks, then posttooluse-dispatch; no SubagentStop fires.
facts.esc: Esc is pressed twice to interrupt (the first shows "esc interrupt"); Stop fires, then the command's PostToolUse with "User aborted the command".
facts.session_end: No SessionEnd hook fires as the chat ends.
facts.title_request: OpenCode asks the model for the chat's title in a request that offers no tools; it is no turn of the chat.
facts.command_timeout: Not measured: the covering script runs no command past a timeout.
